architectural_notes: Current custom ICP0 domain (campus-point-services.icp0.io) appears to be mapped to a deleted/non-existing canister; a new deploy/link or updated domain mapping is required.
known_issues: Public link campus-point-services.icp0.io is not working (likely pointing to deleted/non-existing canister).

existing_features.title: Create a fresh Internet Computer deployment that produces a new working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` (not `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/`), and record the newly generated working URL as the build output (i.e., it must be discoverable in-repo as the latest deployment URL).

Update `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` to replace `[NEW URL TO BE GENERATED]` with the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and reflect that it is the current live deployment (while keeping the previous broken URL listed as deprecated).

Update `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` so the 'Your Live Website URL' section includes the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and references the correct sitemap URL for that deployment.

Ensure Open Graph `og:url` metadata is set to the actual deployed origin at runtime by invoking `updateRuntimePublicUrl()` on app startup (without modifying immutable files), and remove production debug logging from `frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts`.

new_feature_requests.summary: Generate a fresh working ICP0 public link for the app (redeploy / create new canister URL)

projectName: Generate a fresh working ICP0 public URL and update deployment/indexing docs
